question: Should the Agents owner accept the exact-head scoped cache and overlay semantics as preserving the subagent registry’s session-state contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this changes which persisted rows are hydrated on state-sensitive controller and child lookup paths; repository policy calls for owner review of larger session-state behavior changes.

options.title: Approve scoped semantics
options.body: Confirm the tested predicates, overlay precedence, generation ordering, invalidation, and 500 ms consistency window, then merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Request additional state proof
options.body: Require one focused cross-process write/read transcript or test if the existing equivalence and invalidation evidence does not settle the consistency contract.

options.title: Retain full hydration
options.body: Pause the optimization if owners do not want key-scoped caching on registry state despite the measured performance benefit.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm the tested predicates, overlay precedence, generation ordering, invalidation, and 500 ms consistency window, then merge after required checks pass.
